summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands-on embedded systems and firmware experience across STM32, Raspberry Pi, and Arduino platforms. Skilled in bare-metal embedded C/C++, FreeRTOS real-time task coordination, and register-level peripheral programming (GPIO, ADC, I2C, UART) built directly against electrical schematics and component datasheets. Experience spans PCB design, sensor integration, and hardware/firmware/software troubleshooting from prototype through validation.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control, integrating an ADXL345 accelerometer with Raspberry Pi over Bluetooth (HC-05) to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through hardware/software troubleshooting, calibration, and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and hardware integration & troubleshooting end-to-end.

Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots against electrical schematics and datasheets; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in bare-metal embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and low-level I2C drivers.

Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1) against component datasheets and electrical schematics; achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to an STM32 microcontroller over UART.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS real-time systems (RTOS) with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

awards: 1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
